description: Gebäude nach Energiequelle der Heizung is a dataset listed in Datenportal Kanton Schwyz open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für Wirtschaft Kanton Schwyz. Der Datensatz enthält die Anzahl der Gebäude mit Wohnnutzung nach Energiequelle der Heizung und politischer Gemeinde. Quellenangabe: Bundesamt für Statistik, Gebäude- und Wohnungsstatistik. Coverage: Canton of Schwyz. The portal files it under Gebäude und Wohnungen, Energie. Its keywords are Gebäude, Heizung, Energiequelle, Gemeinde. The portal shows 150 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-sz-ch-portal.
